entries.title: Psalms 92:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Thoughts - Thy counsels in the government of the world and of thy church.

entries.title: Psalms 92:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: A brutish man - Who is led by sense, not by reason and faith. This - The depth of God's counsels and works.

entries.title: Psalms 92:10
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Anointed - I shall have cause of testifying my joy by anointing myself, as the manner was at all joyful solemnities.

entries.title: Psalms 92:12
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Palm - tree - Which is constantly green and flourishing.

entries.title: Psalms 92:13
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Planted - Whom God by his gracious providence has fixed there. The house - In its courts; he means in the church of God, whereof all good men are living members.

entries.title: Psalms 92:14
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Old age - Their last days shall be their best days, wherein they shall grow in grace, and increase in blessedness.
